Feed: market 1.246699 against NAV 1.247473, a −6.2bp discount, i.e. the mark is essentially uncontested. ⚠️ THE SCORE IS HELD DOWN BY AN ARCHITECTURE PIVOT IN THE UNDERLYING USDe, NOT BY OBSERVED NAV BEHAVIOUR — the accrual has been well-behaved, and what is priced is that the mechanism generating it is changing. ⚠️ SO A SMOOTH NAV SERIES IS NOT EVIDENCE AGAINST THIS SCORE: it measures forward mechanism risk, and the history was generated by the arrangement being replaced.

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: MEASURES OBSERVED EXIT CAPACITY AT THE THRESHOLD THIS ASSET IS RATED AT. ✅ THE MEASUREMENT: PegTracker clears $2M inside 50bps as a FLOOR on Ethereum — USD-denominated, marginal, first rung subtracted (2026-10-02). ⚠️ A FLOOR IS A LOWER BOUND, NOT A LOCATED LIMIT, AND MAY NOT LIFT A SCORE, so 7.0 is HELD on it rather than raised. Per liquidity-ladder-spec.md §7.8 susde is a -50bps MARGINAL asset — a dollar-denominated share whose NAV is par-or-accruing — which is the STRICTER gate, so $2M clearing inside 50bps is more creditable than the same figure at 200bps, not less. ⚠️ TWO POOL CLAIMS IN THE PRIOR BASIS WERE FALSE AND ARE WITHDRAWN: this field previously read 'Deep Curve sUSDe/USDe and sUSDe/USDC pools'. NO Curve sUSDe/USDe pool exists — the pool usually cited is Synth sUSD/sUSDe, resolved by DexTracker through BOTH token metadata and an on-chain coins(0) call. ⚠️ sUSD and USDe are one letter apart and belong to different issuers (Synthetix, not Ethena). And the Curve sUSDe/USDC pool exists but holds $723.26 — dust, not a venue. ⚠️ THIS FIELD ALSO CALLED ITSELF 'THE HIGHEST LIQUIDITY SCORE IN THIS ROLLOUT'; that superlative is withdrawn as unearned against a misidentified pool. ✅ WHAT IS TRUE, AND IT WAS THE THRUST OF THE ORIGINAL CLAIM: Curve is genuinely the venue — 19 pools holding $74.86M, 95.5% of $78.39M indexed Ethereum swap TVL across 140 pools — alongside 88 Uniswap v4 pools ($2.06M) and 2 Fluid pools ($1.36M). ✅ And the Pendle leg survives: 2 of 17 markets are LIVE ($4.02M Ethereum maturing 2026-11-26, $20.92M Monad maturing 2026-10-22); the other 15 have matured. Selling a PT remains a different kind of exit that broadens routes without touching the cooldown.
liquidity.concentration_note: ⚠️ RECORDED AS A FACT, DELIBERATELY NOT PRICED AS A DEDUCTION. DOLA/sUSDe is the largest single pool at $64.9M — 82.8% of indexed Ethereum swap TVL. An earlier draft of this basis priced that as a concentration deduction and it was WITHDRAWN as overstated: ~$13.5M of non-DOLA depth sits across sDAI, reUSD, scrvUSD, frxUSD, crvUSD and reUSDe Curve pairs PLUS direct sUSDe/USDT pairs on Uniswap v4 ($894K, $594K) and Fluid ($576K). ⚠️ A DIRECT DOLLAR PAIR IS A CLEAN EXIT, NOT A SECOND HOP — which is what the deduction had assumed. And the ladder routes across all venues via an aggregator, so its $2M floor was never a DOLA-only measurement. The concentration is worth a reader knowing and is not worth a point.

liquidity.coverage_limit: ⚠️ ENUMERATION IS DEX-ONLY — GeckoTerminal + DexScreener, neither of which returns centralised exchanges. So the venue figures above are a FLOOR on venue coverage, not a census. CEX depth is deliberately unmeasured (user decision 2026-10-02, recorded in specs/asset-backlog.md as a decision rather than a pending item): the ladder answers the scoring question, while a /tickers feed would return volume and spread — NOT order-book depth — and volume-read-as-depth is the same category error as supply-read-as-depth.
